notes: Mean exclusive scopes partition rank wall, not a global critical path or isolated CPU/GPU arithmetic.
Host callbacks include child reconstruction, packing, communication and waits; local dense scopes cover separators >=1000.
CUDA unions cover selected processes, not SM occupancy; kernel/copy sums can overlap.
Worker stacks inherit only an unambiguous same-process solver time window, not a recovered submitting BLAS/ScaLAPACK caller or main-thread nested phase.
Running-CPU sample fractions are not wall-time fractions. Incomplete worker callers cannot rule out an unobserved ScaLAPACK caller.
The frozen CUDA helper contains a legacy GPU-sharing note; actual bindings verify one MPI rank per GPU.
These are GPU hybrid solver profiles, not a new all-CPU mode0 comparison.
Sparse lookup improves the isolated extraction microbenchmark, but factor ranges overlap and the end-to-end gain is modest.
Do not pool the A/B executables or combine this cohort with helper-enabled or differently instrumented measurements.

semantics: Stage exclusive values partition each rank factor envelope; the callback partition includes only scopes nested within prepare.host_panels.
Native counters are independent diagnostics within those wall scopes, not additional time to add to the exclusive partition.
Native Entry_BF/reconstruct includes CPU GEMM and host V-row MPI, not isolated CPU arithmetic.
Native Traverse includes GPU row fetch, associated request exchange and mapping; it is not a GPU kernel timer.
Native redistribution excludes its preceding barrier. native_unpartitioned also contains mapping/wrapper/cleanup and cannot isolate barrier time.
Native scope wall covers the outer extraction site; for child.F22 this also includes STRUMPACK mapping/packing/communication.
Time_C_Extract/Flop_C_Extract reset unconditionally per native call; Entry counters are differenced. Outer nonempty queries with empty child sublists still enter native extraction.
Zero native flops can include communication or dense block copies, so this does not prove an empty requested matrix.
Scopes are enabled for separator>=1000; BF native/add scopes use BF rows>=1000.
Means, sums and maxima are local rank work, not a reconstructed global critical path.
This is an instrumented single run, not a new quiet timing baseline; do not pool its wall time with the six-trial helper comparison.
Running-CPU worker backtraces inherit only a same-process solver time window. They do not recover the submitting BLAS/ScaLAPACK caller or nested main-thread phase.
CUDA activity unions are not occupancy; kernel/copy sums overlap, and CPU sampling fractions are not solver wall fractions.

next_target.primary: Reduce repeated extraction result redistribution and host packing toward the requesting GPU panel owners.
next_target.candidate_design: Deliver compact child intersections toward the existing 1x1 panel owners, avoiding native-to-child-grid-to-full-child-block-to-parent-owner staging while retaining child communicator membership and all child/current-Schur terms.
next_target.smaller_candidate: Reuse already supplied output owner metadata to avoid rediscovering it with the parent metadata allreduce.
next_target.caution: Collective phase wall includes arrival waits. Removing a collective can move waits to a later exchange; these measurements are not guaranteed elapsed speedups.
next_target.accounting: The combined view substitutes native redistribution subintervals within native calls and combines them with separate STRUMPACK collective scopes; it is not extra time to add to the complete callback partition.
next_target.scope: Reconstruction GPU GEMM alone does not address the dominant measured redistribution/packing chain.

native_counter_freshness.source: Native C_BPACK_ExtractElement resets Time_C_Extract/Flop_C_Extract before sizing and call at SRC/BPACK_wrapper.f90:4255-4256, then sets fresh per-call values at :4275-4276. BF wrapper does likewise at :4173-4174 and :4201-4202.
native_counter_freshness.all_empty_child_sublists: Nonempty outer lI vector still enters native extraction, including legitimate zero-flop MPI work.

blas_worker_pilots.quality: All3 full200-cubed,3RHS sparse solvesPASS; no LAPACK/ScaLAPACK diagnostics; all210 helper calls per case admitted on GPU.
blas_worker_pilots.caveat: Single trial per worker count in one allocation. Neither alternate qualified for confirmation; retain the previously validated16-worker setting. No statistical-significance claim or cross-cohort pooling.

selection_rule.promotion_requires: 3PASS each and same thresholds on group medians

query_pruning_analysis.conclusion: Local zero-flop calls mostly belong to mixed collectives; they cannot skip ranks independently. Zero flops do not prove empty output. Collective query pruning is not the main measured opportunity.
